{{Dialogue|Darth Tenebrous|Continue your efforts to deactivate the unit.|Treddroid|I will, sir. To do that, however, I will need to remain here.|Darth Tenebrous|What of it?|Treddroid|Should I fail in my efforts, the ensuing explosion will surely result in my destruction.|Darth Plagueis|You've been useful, droid.|attr=The two Sith Lords and the treddroid|src=<ref name="Darth P" />}}
A '''treddroid''' served the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] and [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] while the two [[Incident on Bal'demnic|searched]] for valuable [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits. The [[treddroid]] was destroyed by an explosion when the [[Unidentified EM-Two probe droid|EM-Two probe droid]] that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were using to dig for the ore purposely hit a pocket of [[lethane]] gas near the cortosis.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm sorry to report, sirs, that the gas is a highly combustible variant of lethane. The EM-Two unit predicts that the heat generated by its hydraulic jacks will ignite an explosion of significant magnitude.|The treddroid informs the Sith of the gas|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
[[File:Darth Plagueis.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Plagueis, the lone survivor of the Incident on Bal'demnic.]]
In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], a [[treddroid]] accompanied the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], along with an [[Unidentified EM-Two probe droid|EM-Two probe droid]], to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]]. There, near the planet's [[Northern Sea (Bal'demnic)|Northern Sea]], they [[Incident on Bal'demnic|searched]] for the rare and valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]] known as [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]]. In a cave near the deposits, the [[Droid/Legends|treddroid]] monitored and communicated with the [[EM-Two probe droid|EM-Two]] as it evaluated the two lodes of cortosis that they found. However, while the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] was evaluating the second lode, it discovered a pocket of combustible [[lethane]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]], which, if the probe droid continued drilling, would explode.<ref name="Darth P" />

The probe droid halted its drilling, and the treddroid informed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the gas pocket. The two had the probe droid resume and attempt to drill around the gas but momentarily ordered the treddroid to have it stop once again, as the probe droid was actually heading toward a bigger pocket of gas. The probe droid, who had been secretly tasked by [[Subtext Mining]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Sith, continued, deliberately attempting to detonate the gas, despite the treddroid's command to stop. After the treddroid's attempts at deactivating and destroying the probe failed, Plagueis complimented the droid for its usefulness before the Sith fled the area. Staying behind, the treddroid continued to try to deactivate the droid. The treddroid's efforts failed, and the explosion created by the gas destroyed it. Ultimately, only Plagueis survived, as he used the blast as a distraction to [[Rule of Two/Legends|slay]] his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]].<ref name="Darth P" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The unit's inability to respond&mdash;. The unit's refusal to respond appears to be deliberate.|The treddroid, on the EM-Two's betrayal|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
A stubby droid with treds, the treddroid possessed a screen attached to its head that could display a map of the EM-Two probe droid's movements, as well as a graphic analysis of the probe's scans. The treddroid was additionally able to communicate with and monitor the probe droid. As the Sith prepared to leave and ordered the treddroid to continue to attempt to deactivate the probe droid, the treddroid realized that it would be destroyed if it failed. It then thanked Plagueis for his comment on the treddroid's usefulness.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Behind the scenes==
The treddroid first appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth P" />
